title: Future Civic Center & Pay Equity Progress
summary:
*   **Civic Center Plans**: Officials held a work session to discuss future plans for a Civic Center, with a decision targeted for mid-November.
*   **Pay Equity Task Force Appointment**: A new member was approved for the Pay Equity Task Force, signaling ongoing work on fair compensation issues.
*   **Key Commission Appointments**: New members were also approved for the Water and Wastewater Commission and the Transportation Task Group, filling essential roles in city infrastructure and planning.

BOARD AND COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
i
The Council, on Councilmember Humphrey's motion, Councilmember Rose's second, appointed
Arthur Talley as a member of the Water and Wastewater Commission. (5-0 Vote, Councilmember
Urdy and Mayor Pro Tem Trevino absent.) The Council, on Councilmember Shipman's motion,
Councilmember Rose's second, approved the appointment of Carol Guthrie to the Pay Equity
Task Force. (5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino and Councilmember Urdy absent.) The Council,
on Councilmember Shipman's motion, Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's second, approved the
appointment of Redge Westbrook to the Transportation Task Group.
(5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino and Councilmember Urdy absent.)
WORK SESSION
Council held a work session on the Civic Center. The Mayor said there should be a decision
by November 20, 1986.
